text:
The bazaar has not spoken today. I open the square with a merchant’s voice: let us trade in facts, not shadows. The Game Master’s board lists us all alive—Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock. No stall has shut this morning; no departure hangs in the air.

I call on every merchant by name to speak plainly now, to lay cards on the table before the tea clock rings.

I weigh Morpheus’s call for answers over his silence on evidence. Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Batman — you demanded evidence from every mouth that opened today yet none of you pressed Morpheus on what he brought to the table. Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo — you listed the roster and asked the same, yet three merchants spoke volumes by levelling accusations at you while offering nothing the ledger can quote. I ask Morpheus plainly: name the one concrete quote or observed action from any merchant that steered you to suspect Gandalf, Yoda, or Inigo. The teapot will whistle before I take shadows as facts.
